description: Details of waste and recycling submitted pursuant to condition 50 in respect of the Health and Fitness Centre phase of planning permission 00558/A/P55 dated 02/04/2015 for Section 73 application seeking a minor material amendment (reduce site boundary, reduction of B1 floor space, reallocation of parking, changing position of link road and changes to parameters of plots) to planning permission 00558/A/P51 which granted approval for an 'Outline application for the demolition of existing buildings and structures and the development for a media broadcasting and production Campus of up to 104,670sqm (GIA) (now reduced to 95,934m2) comprising office (Class BA1), studio production and research and development facilities (Class B1b) and warehouse/storage (Class B8); hard and soft landscaping; reconfigured and new vehicle and pedestrian accesses and works to the public highway; the provision of parking; and all necessary ancillary and enabling works, plant and equipment
